gloss: burned ruins; fire-damaged site; remains of a fire

definitions.gloss: burned ruins; fire-damaged site; remains of a fire
definitions.explanation: The remaining traces or ruins left behind after something has burned down. Often used to refer to areas devastated by fire, including post-war or post-disaster sites.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}け{跡|あと}を{見|み}つめた。
examples.english: I stared at the burned ruins.

examples.japanese: {戦争|せんそう}の{焼|や}け{跡|あと}から{復興|ふっこう}した{町|まち}だ。
examples.english: It is a town that rebuilt itself from the burned ruins of the war.

examples.japanese: {火事|かじ}の{翌日|よくじつ}、{焼|や}け{跡|あと}には{焦|こ}げた{柱|はしら}だけが{残|のこ}っていた。
examples.english: The day after the fire, only charred pillars remained at the burned site.

notes:
Compound of {焼|や}ける (to burn) + {跡|あと} (trace, mark). Refers to the physical remains of a structure or area destroyed by fire.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焼|や}け{跡|あと}に{立|た}つ: to stand at a burned site
- {戦争|せんそう}の{焼|や}け{跡|あと}: war ruins (postwar usage)
- {焼|や}け{跡|あと}から{復興|ふっこう}する: to rebuild from the ashes
- {焼|や}け{跡|あと}を{片付|かたづ}ける: to clear away the burned remains

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {廃墟|はいきょ}: ruins — broader; any ruined building, not necessarily from fire
- {跡地|あとち}: former site — site where a building once stood, neutral about cause
